entries.meaning_it: articolo determinativo maschile singolare (l' davanti a vocale)
entries.notes: El can; l'omm.

entries.meaning_it: articolo determinativo plurale (maschile; femminile uguale nel profilo)
entries.notes: Feminine plural 'le' is reported for some varieties; this profile uses i.
Feminine ona; plural di.
With a tonic pronoun the subject clitic stays: Mi a voo a scoeula.
Ti te set.

entries.meaning_it: clitico soggetto di 2a persona singolare (te set, te voret)
entries.notes: Obligatory before the verb; ti is optional emphasis.
Spelled lü/luu/lù in sources.

entries.meaning_it: clitico soggetto di 3a persona maschile singolare, davanti al verbo (al in alcune varietà)
entries.notes: (Luu) el dis; lü al màngia minga.
Also num / nun.

entries.meaning_it: voi (informale); vuu è la forma di cortesia

entries.notes: Lü al màngia minga. Variants no / nò also post-verbal: Te seet minga/nò. Older texts (Porta) put no before the verb.

examples.text: Incoeu gh'è tant gent in via.
examples.translation_it: Oggi c'è tanta gente in strada.
examples.translation_en: There are many people on the street today.

entries.notes: Articulated: del, di, de la.
Also in de la, in di.

examples.text: Me pias bev on bicer de vin, ma domà un!
examples.translation_it: Mi piace bere un bicchiere di vino, ma solo uno!
examples.translation_en: I like drinking a glass of wine, but only one!

entries.notes: 3sg l'è for both genders (l'è). 1sg son, 2sg te set/te seet attested in sentences; other persons not documented in the sources read.
Present hoo, hé, hà, hèmm, avìi, hann (Wiktionary); possessive uses add gh-/-gh.
Present fi, fet, fa, fom, fov/fee, fen; participle faa.

examples.text: Te voret andà al mercaa duman?
examples.translation_en: Do you want to go to the market tomorrow?

entries.notes: 1sg voo (Elon); participle andaa; infinitive vs participle differ by length (andà / andaa).
Participle vedüü (classical: vedüü).
Participle dormii.
Model -à verb: mì vardi, tì te vardet, luu el varda, nunch vardom, vialter vardee, lor varden.
1sg pödi / poss.
Mi a soo minga = non lo so.
Attested in Wiktionary as the probable root of pirla (Italian pirlare). Milanese form of the verb not directly documented; treat with care.

Single c: degemination.
Plural fradej (-ll becomes -j).

entries.term: Tant en soo come en saveva
entries.meaning_it: Ne so quanto ne sapevo prima, cioè niente
entries.meaning_en: I know as much as I did before, i.e. nothing

entries.term: Soo pù in che mond me trovi
entries.meaning_it: Non so più in che mondo mi trovo
entries.meaning_en: I no longer know what world I'm in

entries.term: El le sà mèi de mì
entries.meaning_en: He knows it better than I do
To smell trouble (lit. to smell burnt)
To know how to live well
To get carried away with delight
To go to bed early (lit. to the henhouse)

entries.notes: Spelling of the source; the form 'ul' is local, not classical Milanese 'el'.

entries.meaning_it: Smettila di blaterare / tirarla per le lunghe

entries.term: Dimm con chi te vee e te diroo chi te see
entries.meaning_it: Dimmi con chi vai e ti dirò chi sei
entries.meaning_en: Tell me who you go with and I'll tell you who you are
entries.notes: Source writes vee (vett); verb forms here show 2sg te vee.

entries.meaning_it: È un lavoro da arrotino: faticoso e poco redditizio
entries.meaning_en: It's a knife-grinder's job: hard work, little pay

entries.notes: Only a short attestation on a learner page.

entries.meaning_it: Vai a prendere i topi: levati di torno (blando)
entries.meaning_en: Go catch the rats: buzz off (mild)

entries.notes: Source spells Va föra di pè; Va da via i pè in the other list.

entries.meaning_en: Get out from under my feet

entries.meaning_it: Stai zitto e al tuo posto

entries.term: Va a cà a petenà i gaenn!
entries.meaning_it: Vai a casa a pettinare le galline: togliti di mezzo (ironico)
entries.meaning_en: Go home and comb the hens: get lost (ironic)
entries.notes: Source spellings: gaenn / gainn / gajna.

entries.meaning_it: Vai a spazzare il mare: smettila di perdere tempo
entries.notes: Variants add cun la furchèta / cun vert l'umbrela.

entries.term: Va a Bagg a sonà l'òrghen!
entries.meaning_it: Vai a Baggio a suonare l'organo (liquidare qualcuno)
entries.meaning_en: Go play the organ at Baggio (brush-off)
entries.notes: Baggio is a Milan district.

entries.term: Va a cà a fa rustì el lacc!
entries.meaning_it: Vai a casa a far arrostire il latte (invito a sparire)
entries.meaning_en: Go home and roast the milk (go away)

entries.meaning_it: Vai a mungere il toro: è assurdo
entries.meaning_en: Go milk the bull: that's absurd

entries.term: Va a fas dì in gesa!
entries.meaning_it: Togliti dai piedi (lett. fatti dire in chiesa)

entries.notes: Source: someone cheated you or you are stuck; spelling of source.
